name: 桌面控制

description: 让 AI 操作 Windows/macOS 桌面：原生无障碍与离线截图 OCR 定位、点击、中文输入、快捷键、窗口聚焦、滚动与拖拽。macOS 使用内置 Swift 后端，需系统权限与 Apple Command Line Tools。
descriptionEn: Windows/macOS desktop automation with native accessibility and offline OCR: click, type, hotkeys, focus, scroll and drag. macOS uses a bundled Swift helper, system permissions and Apple Command Line Tools.
